facts.fact: 凌晨两点半（Two thirty-five in the morning），叙述者Lucia守在停尸间丈夫Dorian的遗体旁——他一贯苍白，这一次却浑身冰凉。
工作人员询问遗体是否她丈夫，Lucia拒绝确认，说一旦说「是」他们就会把他带走。
facts.quote: “I’m not ready. If I say yes, you’ll take him from me.”

facts.fact: 工作人员告知：车祸是一名女人冲上马路所致，嫌疑人仍在追查中。
facts.quote: A woman ran into the road. We are still trying to locate the suspect.

facts.fact: Lucia用手帕擦拭Dorian的脸却擦不掉印记；他伤深及骨，一只眼睛已被毁掉。
facts.quote: The carnage had taken one eye. The other was badly misshapen.

facts.fact: 她的哥哥Maxim推门而入，斥责工作人员不该让她独自看遗体，用外套挡住停尸台并紧紧抱住她。
facts.quote: “Why would you show her alone?” my brother scolded.

facts.fact: Lucia尖叫「他本该回家」、坚称认错人，气得咬进Maxim的衬衫，他始终抱紧不放手。
facts.quote: I was so angry, I bit into his shirt, but he didn’t let go;

facts.fact: Maxim确认遗体就是Dorian，吩咐不得防腐（以家族意愿为由），随后带Lucia回家。
facts.quote: “Do it. It’s him, I can confirm that,” Maxim said.

facts.fact: Dorian的遗体存进县停尸房；Lucia觉得Dorian以内疚的形式活在她身上。
facts.quote: What remained of my husband was stored in the morgue of the county.
